max_tokens = max_model_len - 16,384 (prompt reserve). Equivalent to the server default "remaining context" for every prompt shorter than 16,384 tokens, but written as a number; prompt lengths are checked before each run
basis.note: README recommends a 262,144 reasoning budget + 131,072 final output where they can be set separately; vLLM cannot, so the context limit applies

basis.source: User 2026-10-13: graders may use lower thinking; chat_template supports xhigh/medium/low

run_policy.cache_schedule: first rubric item of each answer runs alone; the rest follow when it finishes
run_policy.missing_grade_policy: case score undefined and reported; never counted as not met

notes.max_parse_attempts: simple-evals retries forever; capped at 10 and recorded (approved by the user 2026-10-13)
notes.max_transport_attempts: network/429/5xx retries with exponential backoff (infrastructure, not a model setting)
